column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each container record.
A VARCHAR(40) naming or describing the container model/type.
An INTEGER specifying the container's internal volume in liters.
A REAL number for the container’s mass in kilograms (when empty, if applicable).
A VARCHAR(30) field capturing a container status or classification (e.g., ‘In Transit’, ‘Active’, ‘Return’, ‘Delivered’).
A VARCHAR(40) describing the coolant type used within the container (e.g., Dry Ice, Liquid Nitrogen, Phase Change Material).
A REAL number indicating the mass (in kilograms) of the coolant present.
A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the remaining percentage of coolant.
A SMALLINT count of how many times coolant has been refilled.
A DATE recording the most recent coolant refill date.
A DATE for the scheduled or expected next refill date.
A REAL percentage of the container’s internal battery level, if battery-powered components exist.
A VARCHAR(40) indicating the primary power feed or source (e.g., Battery, External, Hybrid).
A VARCHAR(40) specifying backup power availability status (e.g., Available, In Use, Not Available).
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Links this container to a shipment.
